item.title: Supermarket freezers across Europe hit by second suspected cyber-attack
item.description:
📝 An ICA employee in Stockholm cleans out a fridge after supermarket cooling systems across Europe were hit by temperature problems overnight. A company spokesperson, Sarah ‌De Meester, said the supermarket chain had established that temperatures in the cooling systems had increased, adding that the incident was being investigated. ANSSI subsequently confirmed that supermarkets using controllers from two other companies were also targeted in the attack.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/02/supermarket-freezers-across-europe-hit-by-second-suspected-cyber-attack
